text: Move size: 17,766 tracked files under .opencode (17,360 regular, 198 exec, 208 symlinks); .skilled/ tracks one .gitkeep placeholder. A 17.7k-file rename wave, not a directory flip.

Repo ships a purpose-built large-reorg runbook: git mv over raw mv+add; pure renames in separate commits from content edits; verify R-status; post-merge old-prefix sweep; toolchain runs on main after merge (worktree results meaningless); gitignored DBs snapshotted before.

History mechanism proven in-repo (v1.3.2.0: 66 files + 13 dirs via git mv, history preserved, --follow works). Risk is content edits in the rename commit, not scale. Commit plan constrained: rename-only, then edits, then regeneration.

git mv carries no ignored content: 9 ignored entries under .opencode (5 node_modules, 4 dist trees, 1 node-version marker). All four dist trees have tracked=0 — build outputs; the .dist-freshness attestations live inside them untracked. Rebuild on main after merge. Corrects iteration 3's dist accounting.

Symlinks across the move: 174 external relative links dangle at once; 208 internal links travel intact; the 1 out-link resolves at the same depth; .claude/skills and .pi/skills dangle like the rest. Git stores links as mode-120000 blobs and is blind to dangles.

Destination mechanics: .skilled/ already exists with a placeholder dir + .gitkeep, so git mv .opencode .skilled nests into .skilled/.opencode. Contents move or placeholder removed first; the placeholder's own name states the intended shape (contents move, relative links back).

Cached absolute paths that survive: SQLite rows, ~/.codex trust entry, launchd plist template, ~/.claude.json prose; worktree .git pointer references .git not .opencode (unaffected). UNKNOWN: memory/vector DB location and path content (playbook says reindex once on main).

Doc surface: 3,035 tracked md files contain .opencode (excl specs/node_modules; 27,696 incl specs). 816 have fenced-block (runnable) refs; 2,219 inline-only. Distribution: .opencode/skills 2,731; .hermes/skills 68; commands 45; prompts 34/33/33; hooks 21; agents 12x3. Root docs: README 52, PUBLIC-RELEASE 33, AGENTS.md 9, CONTRIBUTING 3, REPO RULES.md 0 (brief correction), repo-rules/* all 0.

Treatment table: 816 fenced-ref files = rewrite-critical (incl 111 SKILL.md, 217 references, 47 commands, 45 hooks, 36 agents); 100 generated stubs = regenerate; root/gate docs = rewrite; 6 SYNC.md = rewrite; 1,710 evidence/prose (playbook 1,054 + benchmark 368 + changelog 288) = freeze/cosmetic; feature-catalog 270 + assets 60 = triage; specs 24,661 = out of rewrite scope.

noveltyJustification: Repo's own large-reorg runbook as authoritative q7 answer; 17,766-file size; ignored-content list + dist-trees-untracked correction; 816/2,219 fenced-vs-inline split; REPO RULES.md correction; treatment table all new.
